reviews.x: Convenient and simple hair dryer. It comes with an attachment that you snap on. I must admit it’s not the easiest to slip on an off but does a good job or channeling the air.  When I turned it in the highest setting there was a slight burn smell, which I’m not sure if that’s from the inner parts of the the heating up to produce the heat but I’ll have to keep my eye on it during long term use.  The cool button option is pretty neat if the air gets too hot for your scalp, you can just hold it down

reviews.t: Exactly what I needed for my trip
reviews.x: With limited room in my suitcase for a 9 day cruise, I was looking for something that was light, small, but offered the quality of a professional hairdryer. This fit all my needs! My roommate even used it the entire time. It has an extra long cord which I didn’t need for this trip, but can come in handy in future trips, when staying in hotels, where the outlets might not be in a great location. I highly recommend this product.
Looks just like it’s picture! Works well, and dries my hair fast. Also, it looks like a Dyson for a fraction of the price. Definitely recommend!

Hair dryer caught on fire within a minute of using it for the first time. Set all the smoke detectors off in the hotel I was staying at.  This was even the 2nd one because the first one I ordered didn’t work at all. DO NOT BUY THIS!!!!!

reviews.t: Powerful dryer with very nice design
reviews.x: I am happy with this powerful dryer with a pretty modern design. The handle can be fold easily and it’s very light for travel. The quality is much better than I thought. Really love the modern look of it!

reviews.t: Powerful dryer with very nice design
reviews.x: I am happy with this powerful dryer with a pretty modern design. The handle can be fold easily and it’s very light for travel. The quality is much better than I thought. Really love the modern look of it!

[[VIDEOID:7942cd25428b42470fba44d78e4045e3]] Surprisingly the weight of this hairdryer is lighter than my dyson hairdryer. Definitely is a struggle when I need bring my dyson hairdryer for short trip or holiday because it is too expensive to leave at hotel room. The volume and heat can dry up my long hair quickly. One of the favorite part I prefer is, the head of the dryer is adjustable which makes life easier.

reviews.t: Small and powerful, perfect for travel and home
reviews.x: Bought this to keep in my suitcase for traveling, and am so excited! It is super powerful, the attachment that directs the air stays on and rotates . Hair dries quickly.  Folds easily. This is such a great dryer I would probably replace my home hair dryer with this one when that one breaks. Very very happy.
Sleek, pretty, perfect size for traveling

reviews.t: Nice comfortable to use hair dryer
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:34dbdf647e3e6450702d6fbc66d9a078]] comfortable to hold and very light weight.  It folds easy and blows both hot or cold air so I like that option  It is exactly as described by the seller.  I did notice the new smell when I first used it as it was heating up but I am sure that will go away with use as it has with other hair dryers  Nicely packaged and instruction are easy to read.  Seems to be great for travel or at home use.

I am very happy with this purchase. This has become my go to hair dryer. I love it, it looks so much more expensive. It is a great dupe for the dyson hair dryer. It is very powerful for the size, it came with an attachment which was a plus. Very sturdy I must say this is one of my best purchase from Amazon, which 90 percent of my purchases are from Amazon. I am extremely pleased as you now can tell with this purchase.

The hair dryer I received looks just like the one in the picture however it's not right.  The picture and what u thought I was going to receive was a 1600W the box it came in says 1600W however the sticker that was put on it and what the blow dryer says is 1200W. So was very disappointed with that. Would be a very nice blow dryer if it was the right one I had paid for....

Bought this hair dryer for the size and 2 yr guarantee. Never heard of this brand before. Despite the description on the internet, the box and dryer state it's 1200W, not 1600W. I was leary as my old dryer is 1875W and drys my hair fairly quickly. That being said, I was surprised that this one is quieter and takes the same amount of time to dry as my previous dryer. The cord is substantial and the size good for traveling. The diffuser works well and the cold shot is nice to have.  The unit itsel

This product is comfortable for traveling, is very powerful, and has a lovely interface. It has a long cable which is useful when your power source is not close to your make-up table. Additionally, I've contacted their support for several questions and got the best service from them. It's adorable when a company appreciates its customers.

reviews.t: Not powerful but dries quicker & healthier for your hair
reviews.x: Ok so I have long, middle of back, fine to medium hair. This dryer looks good, is light weight and small which is good for travel. When I used it for the first time, I thought it wasn't powerful enough, nor hot enough to do anything I was expecting and was a bit disappointed. However, after a few uses I found that my hair dries faster and looks healthier because of less heat and drying time. So if you are expecting a powerful, hot blow dryer this is not for you, but if you are looking for a drie
This thing rocks and gives me the ability to get my hair styled just like the barber does. Downside is it’s a big boy even when folded so I’d say “travel friendly” is an overstatement at best.
It’s okay. I don’t feel it’s powerful enough. It’s got a super long cord! And it’s foldable. It has its pros, but I’d prefer a much more powerful air flow. Takes forever to dry my hair.
Pretty sure I received a used unit. No instructions and the concentrator attachment wasn’t in the box. It works and it’s lightweight so there’s that.
It’s okay nice for travel but handle gets to hot if you use it for a while. I have long hair and handle would get hot by the time I finished
This dryer is light weight, fairly quiet, and dries hair quickly. I’m able to give myself a blowout without arm and wrist fatigue.
It's reasonably quiet, plenty of power and easy to hold.  The lower speed doesn't have much heat though, hence the 4 stars.
The power isn’t great and the back of it eats your hair. Not good for long hair or curly hair.

Great small blow dryer, I work as a stylist in the salon and was sick of forking out $100+ for a new blow dryer 2x a year from usage so I thought I’d try this one, works awesome only downfall doesn’t have more then one temperature setting just speed but it works great! Get lots of compliments on it as well. Cord is long enough 6.5ft

reviews.t: Works well, easy to use, but very loud.
reviews.x: I like the hi heat setting, because it’s milder (not baking hot) than most hair dryers I’ve used.  However, I dislike how loud it is.  I was surprised at the amount of noise, compared to my old folding Conair travel dryer, which I’m replacing because the on/off switch broke.  Also, the size is less compact than my old travel dryer.

When I initially received this hair dryer I loved it.  However about about 4 months in and I thought I noticed a decline in power and today it will not turn on.  I was considering giving it as Christmas presents but I think I’ll have to pass.  It’s a shame because i really likes it until it quit.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the dryer as compact, lightweight, and easy to fold, making it ideal for travel.
Many customers describe it as powerful for its size and note that it dries hair quickly.
Several reviewers compare it favorably to a Dyson, calling it a good-looking dupe at a fraction of the price.
Some reviewers report a burning or new smell when first using it on high heat.
A few reviewers report wattage discrepancies (1200W instead of the advertised 1600W) and serious safety failures, including a unit catching fire.
